title: Tiny, cute wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Watch strap top -->
  <rect x="42" y="8" width="16" height="28" rx="6" fill="#c0392b"/>
  <rect x="44" y="10" width="12" height="8" rx="3" fill="#e74c3c"/>
  <rect x="44" y="24" width="12" height="8" rx="3" fill="#e74c3c"/>
  <!-- Watch strap bottom -->
  <rect x="42" y="64" width="16" height="28" rx="6" fill="#c0392b"/>
  <rect x="44" y="66" width="12" height="8" rx="3" fill="#e74c3c"/>
  <rect x="44" y="80" width="12" height="8" rx="3" fill="#e74c3c"/>
  <!-- Buckle -->
  <rect x="45" y="86" width="10" height="4" rx="2" fill="#f1c40f"/>
  <!-- Watch body outer ring -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="22" fill="#f39c12"/>
  <!-- Watch body inner ring -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="18" fill="#f1c40f"/>
  <!-- Watch face -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="15" fill="#2c3e50"/>
  <!-- Hour markers -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="1.8" fill="#ecf0f1"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="1.8" fill="#ecf0f1"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="50" r="1.8" fill="#ecf0f1"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="50" r="1.8" fill="#ecf0f1"/>
  <!-- Hour hand -->
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="50" y2="42" stroke="#e74c3c" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Minute hand -->
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="58" y2="46" stroke="#ecf0f1" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Center dot -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="2" fill="#f1c40f"/>
  <!-- Crown -->
  <rect x="70" y="46" width="5" height="8" rx="2" fill="#e67e22"/>
  <!-- Strap holes -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="78" r="1.5" fill="#922b21"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="84" r="1.5" fill="#922b21"/>
</svg>
